digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 reconciler vendor adapter seam documentation
propositions: isinstance checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols silently return False on Python 3.12+ for dynamically-proxying objects because CPython gh-102433 switched to inspect.getattr_static which does not honor __getattr__

ADR-0083 prescribed isinstance-only capability detection, which is correct on Python 3.11 but incorrect on Python 3.12+, creating a silent soft failure where proxies fail the check despite having the capability
The single executable capability dispatch site (dispatch_apply_phases.py:188) already implements the safe pattern (isinstance primary with hasattr fallback), but the ADR text remains unsafe
A tree-wide sweep found zero other isinstance-against-Supports sites and confirmed all capability checks are already proxy-safe by construction or by hasattr fallback
